notes: Identity independently inspected: title The Bias Blind Spot: Perceptions of Bias in Self Versus Others, authors Emily Pronin, Daniel Y. Lin and Lee Ross, PSPB Vol. 28 No. 3 March 2002 pp. 369–381 match the original reference. Supplied document is primary article text with methods/results and references across pp. 369–381, not an abstract or secondary article. DOI is not printed, so DOI identity is not independently corroborated. No PDF supplied; figure graphics are absent in text. If Sample 1 means Survey 1, the requested three-limitation outcome is absent: Survey 2 explicitly introduced these items. Survey 1’s 24 participants and eight-bias t(23) = 8.31, p < .0001 are a different outcome and cannot fill this target. If Sample 1 denotes a different sampling scheme, it is not identified in supplied locators. No Survey 2/3 statistics substituted. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
